newsitem.title: CANADA: Minorca agrees to C$61 million financing.
newsitem.headline: Minorca agrees to C$61 million financing.

text.p: Minorca Resources Inc said on Thursday it agreed to complete a private placement of 10 million special warrants at a price of C$6.10 per special warrant for gross proceeds of C$61 million.
Minorca said each special warrant would entitle the holder to acquire one common share and one half of one common share purchase warrant.

Each whole warrant entitled the holder to purchase one common share at a price of C$7.15 per common share at any time on or prior to the first anniversary of the closing of the offering, Minorca said.
Underwriters were also granted the option to purchase an additional one million special warrants for a period of 30 days after the closing of the offering.

The net proceeds of the offering would be used by Minorca to fund future obligations relating to its seven percent interest in the net profits from the southeast zones of the Busang gold deposit and to fund future acquisitions.
